school: 晚明'以情为本'的戏剧体系构建者：以《牡丹亭》把'情'立为解释世界的第一原理（因情成梦、因梦成戏），以临川四梦让同一母题承载四个互异体系，以情理对峙的完整戏剧结构为价值冲突造程序性出口，以'意趣神色为主'的标准排序公案对抗格律至上，以亲手建设宜黄班为自己的作品落实执行载体，最终以弃官与玉茗堂孤守完成志业——他是把主观体验做成可传承精密体系的人
historical_significance: 汤显祖（1550-1616），字义仍，号海若、若士，临川人；万历十一年（1583）进士，历任南京太常寺博士、礼部主事；万历十九年（1591）上《论辅臣科臣疏》抨击朝政，贬徐闻典史，后迁浙江遂昌知县；万历二十六年（1598）弃官归临川，同年完成《牡丹亭》；一生剧作以《紫钗记》《牡丹亭》《南柯记》《邯郸记》并称'临川四梦'，其中《牡丹亭》'家传户诵，几令《西厢》减价'；他在《牡丹亭题词》中提出'情不知所起，一往而深，生者可以死，死可以生'，以'情'对抗程朱理学的'存天理灭人欲'；与沈璟的汤沈之争中主张'凡文以意趣神色为主'，宁拗折天下人嗓子不伤意趣；著《宜黄县戏神清源师庙记》为戏曲行当立传，亲授宜伶戏理；晚年居临川玉茗堂著述终老，卒于万历四十四年，与莎士比亚同年；他证明：主观的'情'可以被建成一个精密、自洽、可传承四百年的思想-艺术体系
historical_significance_en: Tang Xianzu (1550-1616), courtesy name Yireng, sobriquets Hai Ruo and Ruoshi, a native of Linchuan; a jinshi of 1583, he served as erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices at Nanking and secretary of the Ministry of Rites; in 1591 his memorial against the ministers of state enraged the powerful and he was demoted to Xuwen, later magistrate of Suichang; in 1598 he resigned and returned to Linchuan, and in that year finished the Peony Pavilion; his four dramas, the purple hairpin, the peony, the southern bough and the Handan dream, are together the Four Dreams of Linchuan, and the Peony 'passed from house to house, nearly casting the Western Chamber from favor'; in its inscription he wrote that feeling, of unknown origin, goes deep and further — the living may die of it, the dead may live again — setting feeling against the Cheng-Zhu order of principle over desire; in the quarrel with Shen Jing he held all writing takes meaning, flavor, spirit, color as master, rather bend the world's throat than wound the sense; his temple record of the Yihuang stage god gave the acting calling its history, and he taught the Yihuang players himself; his last years passed in the Yumingtang at Linchuan, and he died in 1616, the year of Shakespeare; he proved that subjective feeling can be built into a precise, self-consistent, four-hundred-year transmissible system of thought and art
unique_thinking: 汤显祖思维模式的独特性在于五条主线的合成：第一，'第一原理的另选'——在人人以'理'为基元的时代，他选定'情'并为它立法（如何起、如何深、如何死而复生），让主观体验接受逻辑约束而成为体系；第二，'虚构先行'——因情成梦、因梦成戏、按梦索骥，虚构被当作现实的先行组织形式，梦比现实更早也更认真地测绘了生活；第三，'母题轨道'——临川四梦以'梦'一个母题向相反方向展开（达成/废除），同一根梁撑起四座互异的建筑；第四，'排序公案'——意趣为主、格律为仆，宁拗折天下人嗓子，把'作品为什么存在'置于'作品如何被规范'之上，并公开预付排序的代价；第五，'作者下场建载体'——建宜黄班、写庙记、亲授戏理，把作品生命力理解为内容×载体的乘积；五线共同指向一件事：让最不可言说的东西（情）获得最可传承的形式（体系），并亲自守护这个形式四百年不散
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Tang Xianzu's thinking is a synthesis of five lines. First, the choice of another first principle — in an age whose base element was reason he chose feeling and legislated for it, how it rises, deepens, kills and revives, binding subjective experience under logic until it became a system. Second, fiction goes first — feeling forms the dream, the dream the play, and the dream hunted through the world like a map: fiction as reality's advance formation, measuring life earlier and more earnestly than life does. Third, the motif as rail — the four dreams unfold one motif in opposite directions, fulfillment and abolition, one beam holding four unlike buildings. Fourth, the case in ordering — meaning over meter, rather bend the world's throat; why a work exists set above how it is regulated, and the price of the ordering paid in public. Fifth, the author descends to build the carrier — the troupe formed, the temple record written, the players taught by his own mouth: a work's life as content times carrier. The five lines share one direction: to win the least sayable thing, feeling, the most transmissible form, a system — and to guard that form, by hand, against four hundred years of scattering
civilization_zh: 晚明的临川与遂昌——一个在科举与仕途上早慧的人，把一生走成了两条路：前半生是直臣的路，二十一岁中举、因一篇《论辅臣科臣疏》触怒权臣而贬谪徐闻、迁遂昌知县，五年善政之后看清了万历朝的天花板，交印弃官，不回头；后半生是玉茗堂的路，弃官的同年《牡丹亭》成书，接着《南柯记》《邯郸记》，四梦并峙；他与宜黄伶人交往、教戏、写庙记，为一门行当立传正名；他与沈璟论战，坚称'凡文以意趣神色为主'，宁拗折天下人嗓子不伤意趣；万历四十四年他卒于临川，与莎士比亚同年——一个用'情'作第一原理的人，把被礼教压住的世界在舞台上完整建成，四百年不散
civilization_en: Linchuan and Suichang, the late Ming — a man early brilliant in examination and office walked his life as two roads. The first half was the road of the frank official: a provincial graduate at twenty-one, exiled to Xuwen for one memorial against the ministers of state, moved to magistrate of Suichang; five years of good rule showed him the ceiling of the Wanli court, and he handed back the seal, resigned, and did not look back. The second half was the road of the Yumingtang: in the year of his resignation the Peony Pavilion was finished, then the Southern Bough and the Handan dreams — four dreams standing together. He kept company with the Yihuang players, taught them, wrote the temple record of their stage god, gave a calling its history and its name. He quarreled with Shen Jing over prosody and held that all writing takes meaning, flavor, spirit, color as master — rather bend the world's throat than wound the meaning. He died at Linchuan in the forty-fourth year of Wanli, the year of Shakespeare's death — a man who took feeling for his first principle, and built whole, upon the stage, the world that rite had shut out; four hundred years and it has not dispersed

cross_references.description_zh: 汤显祖与董仲舒代表'为世界立第一原理'的两个方向：董仲舒以'天'统摄宇宙人事，为秩序赋予意义，情须屈从于天的安排；汤显祖以'情'统摄生死梦觉，为主观体验争得本体地位，理的疆域反过来要为情让步；两人都做的是'选一个统摄性基元并为之立法'的知识工程，差异在于董仲舒的工程向上收束于秩序，汤显祖的工程向下扎根于个人——对照命题：一个文明的解释体系里，秩序与人心都需要一个不可再分的基元，而两个基元必须谈判边界。
cross_references.description_en: Tang Xianzu and Dong Zhongshu mark two directions of founding a first principle for the world: Dong took heaven as the element governing cosmos and human affairs, giving order its meaning, with feeling bent to heaven's arrangement; Tang took feeling to govern life, death, dream and waking, winning ontological standing for inner experience, with reason's territory made to yield. Both built the same engineering — choose one governing element and legislate for it; the difference: Dong's building closes upward into order, Tang's roots downward into the person. The contrast: in a civilization's explanatory system both order and the human heart need an indivisible base element — and the two elements must negotiate their border.

cross_references.description_zh: 汤显祖与张载同为'为无形之物立法'的体系构建者：张载为'气'立本体论（太虚即气），为价值立四句教（为天地立心）；汤显祖为'情'立本体论（生者可以死，死可以生），为戏剧立功能论（宜黄庙记论动情之力）；两人都把一个抽象基元做成了有结构、有功能、可传承的体系；差异在于张载的体系靠书院与门人传承，汤显祖的体系靠舞台与伶人传承——同一件事（抽象基元工程化），两套完全不同的载体选择。
cross_references.description_en: Tang Xianzu and Zhang Zai are both system-builders who legislated for the intangible: Zhang Zai founded an ontology for qi, the great void itself qi, and the four sentences of value — setting the heart for heaven and earth; Tang founded an ontology for feeling — the living may die, the dead may live — and a theory of drama's function in the Yihuang temple record, the power to move. Both made an abstract element into a structured, functional, transmissible system; the difference: Zhang Zai's system passed through academies and pupils, Tang's through stages and players — one work of element-engineering, two wholly different carriers chosen.

cross_references.description_zh: 汤显祖与关汉卿同为把'人间世'搬上舞台的戏剧体系构建者，且都亲自下场做执行侧（关汉卿'躬践排场'自演自导，汤显祖教宜伶、立庙记）：关汉卿的舞台以'本色'直接呈现底层血肉，汤显祖的舞台以'意趣'经营多层文本；两人都证明戏剧不只是文本而是一个需要载体、排场、表演标准协同的完整系统——差异在于关汉卿向下扎根市井即时性，汤显祖向上建构可传承四百年的精密体系。
cross_references.description_en: Tang Xianzu and Guan Hanqing are both builders of dramatic systems that put the human world on the stage, and both descended to execution themselves — Guan treading the boards, staging and directing his own plays; Tang teaching the Yihuang players and writing their temple record. Guan's stage presents the flesh of the lowly direct, by native color; Tang's stage engineers a layered text by meaning and flavor. Both proved drama is not a text but a whole system of carrier, staging and performance standard working together — the difference: Guan roots downward into the streets and the present moment, Tang builds upward into a precise system made to cross four hundred years.

cross_references.description_zh: 汤显祖与黄宗羲都经历了与体制的决裂并完成了身份重定义，方向相反：黄宗羲由反宦官权贵之子而学者史家，以《明夷待访录》向未来制度立法，弃的是'忠君'而留的是'经世'；汤显祖由直臣而戏曲家，以弃官把政治资本转投艺术志业，弃的是'经世'而留的是'至情'；两人都做了'退场即转移'的身份工程——对照命题：当体制身份与志业冲突时，资本可以向制度的未来转移（黄），也可以向人心的深处转移（汤）。
cross_references.description_en: Tang Xianzu and Huang Zongxi both broke with the establishment and redefined their identities, in opposite directions: Huang, son of the anti-eunuch cause, became scholar and historian, legislating for future institutions in the Waiting for the Dawn, resigning loyalty to the throne while keeping statecraft; Tang, the frank minister, turned playwright, transferring his political capital by resignation into an artistic vocation, resigning statecraft while keeping sovereign feeling. Both performed the same identity engineering, exit as transfer — the contrast: when institutional identity and vocation conflict, capital may be moved toward the future of institutions, Huang's way, or toward the depths of the human heart, Tang's.

modes.category: 认知方法/以'情'为世界第一原理
modes.domain_zh: 汤显祖一生的哲学支点是一个'情'字：他在《牡丹亭题词》里写下'情不知所起，一往而深，生者可以死，死可以生'——情不是修辞，而是他解释世界运转的第一原理；这个判断的深意在于：第一，情有本体论地位——杜丽娘因梦而死、因情而生的设定，是把'不可验证的内在状态'当作比生理事实更硬的存在；第二，情可以结构化——《牡丹亭》五十五出里，情的展开是一条完整的逻辑链（游园、惊梦、寻梦、写真、冥判、还魂），每个环节都有因果；第三，情与理划界——他说'第云理之所必无，安知情之所必有'，承认理有管辖不到的疆域，并为这片疆域立法；他证明：一套认知体系的第一原理不必选'理性'——选定一个足以统摄全部现象的基元（他的'情'），再让它接受自己定下的逻辑约束，同样可以建成精密的体系
modes.domain_en: The philosophical pivot of Tang Xianzu's life was a single word, feeling: in the inscription to The Peony Pavilion he wrote, 'feeling, of unknown origin, goes deep and further — the living may die of it, the dead may live again' — not rhetoric, but his first principle of how the world runs. The depth of the judgment: first, feeling has ontological standing — Du Liniang's dying of a dream and living again through love sets an unverifiable inner state as harder fact than the body; second, feeling can be structured — across the pavilion's fifty-five scenes, feeling unfolds as a complete logical chain, the garden, the dream, the sought dream, the portrait, the underworld judgment, the return, each link causal; third, feeling is bounded against reason — 'say what reason holds impossible; who knows what feeling holds certain,' he grants reason its territory and legislates for the rest. He proved: a cognitive system's first principle need not be reason — choose one element sufficient to govern all phenomena, his feeling, and bind it by its own logic, and a precise system can be built
modes.source_chapter: 《牡丹亭·题词》：'情不知所起，一往而深，生者可以死，死可以生……第云理之所必无，安知情之所必有'；《牡丹亭》五十五出结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 情不知所起，一往而深，生者可以死，死可以生——情不是修辞，是解释世界的第一原理
modes.key_quote_en: "Feeling, of unknown origin, goes deep and further — the living may die of it, the dead may live again: feeling is not rhetoric but the first principle of the world."
process_zh: 选定足以统摄全部现象的第一原理：不随主流选'理'而选'情'——基元的选择决定体系的疆域与形状
为第一原理立法：给'情'立下自己的因果规则（如何起、如何深、如何死而复生）——基元也要受逻辑约束才成体系
在与对立原理的边界处下定义：明说'理之所必无，安知情之所必有'——体系的疆界在 contrasts 中最清晰
用一个极端案例把原理推到极限：让主角为情而死又为情而生——原理只有在极限处才显示出统摄力
process_en: Choose a first principle sufficient to govern all phenomena: not the age's reason but feeling — the choice of the base element fixes a system's territory and shape
Legislate for the principle: give feeling its own causal rules — how it rises, deepens, kills and revives; a base element under logic is what makes a system
Define the principle at its border with the rival: 'what reason holds impossible, who knows what feeling holds certain' — a system's frontier is clearest in contrast
Push the principle to its limit with one extreme case: let the heroine die for love and live again by it — only at the limit does a principle show its governing power
representative_cases_zh: 杜丽娘游园惊梦：一场梦在剧中的因果地位高于她的实际死亡——内在体验被当作第一因果事件处理
《牡丹亭·题词》的立论次序：先承认生死的生理事实，再断言情可以推翻它——原理与常识的冲突被正面写出而非回避
《南柯记》《邯郸记》的'情尽'结构：两剧以情起、以梦醒收束——同一个第一原理被用来测量自身的边界
representative_cases_en: Du Liniang's garden dream: one dream holds a causal standing in the play above her actual death — inner experience treated as the first causal event

The order of argument in the Peony Pavilion inscription: the bodily fact of death conceded first, then the claim that feeling overturns it — the clash of principle and common sense written head-on, not dodged
The 'exhaustion of feeling' structure in A Dream Under the Southern Bough and The Handan Dream: both rise in feeling and close in waking — the same first principle used to sound its own boundary
modern_applications_zh: 为复杂领域选第一原理：做知识体系前先问'哪一条基元统摄得了全部现象'（如用户体验行业的'注意力'、经济学的'激励'）——选错基元，体系越精密越扭曲
给主观体验建立因果链：用户调研、访谈记录这类'软材料'可以像《牡丹亭》一样被结构化成有因果的叙事，而非情绪碎片
在原理与主流的边界处立'管辖协议'：明确哪些现象归理、哪些归情——现代组织里'数据与直觉'的分工就该这样明文化
modern_applications_en: Choose the first principle for a complex field: before building a knowledge system ask which single element governs every phenomenon — attention for user experience, incentive for economics; the wrong base distorts the finer the system
Give subjective experience a causal chain: soft material — user research, interview notes — can be structured, like the Pavilion, into causal narrative rather than shards of sentiment

Write the jurisdiction agreement at the border with the rival principle: which phenomena belong to reason, which to feeling — in modern organizations the division between data and intuition deserves the same explicit charter

modes.name_en: The Method of the Dream Made Real
modes.category: 认知方法/把虚构当作真实的实验场
modes.domain_zh: 《牡丹亭》的戏剧装置核心是一个问题：如果一场梦比现实更真实，该服从哪一个？杜丽娘梦中所见的书生在现实中存在，她按梦寻人，死在寻找的路上，又以鬼身找到真人——虚构在此不是与真实对立，而是真实的前导；这个方法的四个环节：第一，虚构先行——先用梦（假想、模型、推演）生成一个完整图景，不等现实批准；第二，按图索骥——把虚构图景当作可搜索的地图，到现实里找对应物；第三，付出生死代价——杜丽娘为梦而死，说明按虚构行动要承担真实后果，虚构的严肃性由代价度量；第四，虚构与实在合拢——还魂之后，梦中的爱情被现实承认，虚构完成了向真实的兑换；他证明：虚构不是现实的劣质替代品，而是现实的先行组织形式——最深的真实常常先以'不可能之物'的形态到来
modes.domain_en: The dramatic device at the heart of The Peony Pavilion is a question: if a dream is more real than reality, which obeys which? The young man Du Liniang sees in her dream exists in the waking world; she seeks him by the dream, dies on the road of seeking, and finds the living man as a ghost — fiction here is not the opposite of the real but its scout. The method has four pieces: first, fiction goes first — a dream, a model, a projection generates a whole picture before reality approves; second, hunt by the map — take the fictional picture as a searchable map and look in reality for its counterpart; third, pay in life and death — Du Liniang dies for her dream: acting on fiction bears real consequence, and fiction's seriousness is measured in what it costs; fourth, fiction and fact close: after the return to life the dreamed love is ratified by the waking world — fiction redeemed into the real. He proved: fiction is not reality's poor substitute but its advance formation — the deepest truth often arrives first in the shape of the impossible

modes.key_quote_zh: 梦中之情，何必非真——虚构不是现实的替代品，而是现实的先行组织形式
modes.key_quote_en: "Feeling within a dream — why must it be unreal? Fiction is not reality's substitute but its advance formation."
process_zh: 让虚构先行完整成形：不问'现实允许吗'，先把假想推演成有细节的完整图景——未经推演的机会无从识别
把虚构当作地图而非逃避：列出图景中的可检验坐标（人物、场景、条件），到现实中逐一寻找对应
为按虚构行动定价：明确'如果梦是错的，我付出什么'——不承担代价的虚构是幻想，承担代价的虚构是实验
设定合拢条件：预先写明'什么证据出现时，虚构被现实承认'——还魂要有冥判与回生两道程序
process_en: Let fiction complete itself first: without asking reality's leave, project the conjecture into a detailed whole picture — an unprojected chance cannot be recognized
Treat fiction as map, not escape: list the testable coordinates in the picture — persons, scenes, conditions — and hunt their counterparts in the real
Price the acting on fiction: state plainly what is paid if the dream is wrong — fiction that bears no cost is fantasy; fiction that bears cost is experiment
Set the closing condition: write in advance what evidence, arriving, ratifies fiction as real — even the return to life went through judgment in the dark and the rite of waking
representative_cases_zh: 杜丽娘'寻梦'：她不是被动等待梦境重演，而是按梦的细节回园林逐处核对——把梦当作可以田野调查的对象
柳梦梅拾画叫画：现实中的柳梦梅捡到杜丽娘自画的写真，朝夕称呼，竟使画中人还魂——虚构肖像成了复活的操作手册
汤显祖弃官著曲：他在现实仕途里实现不了的'至情世界'，先在戏剧里完整建成，再让四百年的舞台把它兑换成现实影响
representative_cases_en: Du Liniang 'seeking the dream': she does not wait for the dream to repeat but walks the garden checking its details one by one — the dream treated as an object of field survey
Liu Mengmei and the portrait: the living man finds the heroine's self-portrait, calls to it day and night, and calls her back — a fictional image as the operating manual of resurrection

Tang Xianzu leaving office for the stage: the world of sovereign feeling he could not build in his career he built whole in drama first — and four hundred years of stages exchanged it back into real effect
modern_applications_zh: 把'假设的完整化'设为流程起点：新产品、新战略先推演成有细节的完整故事（谁在用、怎么用、为什么留），再去找市场验证——碎片化的点子经不起按图索骥
给虚构式推演标定代价与合拢条件：沙盘、兵棋、压力测试都要写明'错了付什么、什么证据算数'——没有这两条的推演是娱乐
识别'先到的虚构'：对那些以不可能形态出现的信号（离谱的用户来信、极端的边角案例）建立正式观察通道——它们常是现实的前导
modern_applications_en: Make the completion of conjecture the starting step of process: a product or strategy first projected as a detailed story — who uses it, how, why they stay — then taken to the market; fragmentary ideas cannot survive being hunted by the map
Price and close every fictional exercise: war games, sand tables, stress tests must state what is paid if wrong and what evidence counts — without both, the exercise is entertainment
Build a formal channel for 'fiction that arrives first': impossible-seeming signals — absurd user letters, extreme edge cases — get observed on purpose; they are often reality's scouts

modes.name_en: The Method of the Four Dreams of Linchuan
modes.category: 方法论/用一个统一母题承载互异的体系
modes.domain_zh: 汤显祖的四部代表作——《紫钗记》《牡丹亭》《南柯记》《邯郸记》——全部以'梦'为结构支点，世称'临川四梦'；但四个梦各说一事：紫钗记梦在团圆，牡丹亭梦在还魂，南柯梦在浮荣成空，邯郸梦在大道彻悟——同一个母题被用作四个不同体系的承重梁；这个方法的要害：第一，母题要足够深——'梦'既可以是欲望的达成（前两梦），也可以是欲望的废除（后两梦），一个母题必须能向相反方向展开才算真深；第二，变奏而非重复——四剧在结构同构（入梦、历境、出梦）之下装入完全不同的命题，观众靠熟悉的结构进入陌生的思想；第三，系列自证——四梦并置时互相注释：前两梦证明情之实，后两梦证明情之空，合起来才是汤显祖的完整世界观；他证明：统一的母题不是内容的贫乏，而是体系的轨道——同一根梁可以撑起四座互异的建筑
modes.domain_en: Tang Xianzu's four masterworks — the Story of the Purple Hairpin, the Peony Pavilion, A Dream Under the Southern Bough, the Handan Dream — all rest on one structural pivot, the dream, and the world calls them the Four Dreams of Linchuan. Yet each dream says a different thing: the purple hairpin's dream of reunion, the peony's dream of return from death, the southern bough's dream of glory come to nothing, the Handan dream of awakening to the Way — one motif carrying four different systems. The crux: first, the motif must run deep — the dream can be desire's fulfillment, the first two plays, or desire's abolition, the last two; a motif able to unfold in opposite directions is truly deep. Second, variation, not repetition — beneath the isomorphic structure, entering dream, passing through, waking, each play loads an entirely different proposition; audiences enter strange thought by a familiar door. Third, the series proves itself — set side by side the four gloss one another: the first two prove feeling real, the last two prove it empty, and together they are Tang Xianzu's whole view. He proved: a unified motif is not poverty of content but the rail of a system — one beam can hold four unlike buildings
modes.source_chapter: 《临川四梦》（紫钗记、牡丹亭、南柯记、邯郸记）；汤显祖自言'一生四梦，得意处惟在牡丹'
modes.key_quote_zh: 一生四梦——统一母题不是内容的贫乏，而是体系的轨道：同一根梁可以撑起四座互异的建筑
modes.key_quote_en: "Four dreams in one life — a unified motif is not poverty of content but a system's rail: one beam can hold four unlike buildings."
process_zh: 选一个能向相反方向展开的深母题：好的母题是双刃的（梦=达成/废除），只指向一个方向的母题撑不起体系
固定结构骨架、轮换内容命题：入梦—历境—出梦的骨架不变，每件作品装不同的核心命题——结构是入口，命题是房间
让系列内部互相注释：为每件作品安排与其他作品的对位关系（情之实对情之空）——体系感来自作品间的张力而非各自孤立
标定得意之作：承认系列中作品有高下（'得意处惟在牡丹'）——不因体系完整而掩盖代表作的锋芒
process_en: Choose a deep motif able to unfold both ways: a good motif is double-edged, dream as fulfillment and as abolition; a one-way motif cannot carry a system
Freeze the structural frame, rotate the proposition: entering, passing through, waking — frame constant, each work loading a different core claim; structure the entrance, propositions the rooms
Let the series gloss itself: arrange each work in counterpoint to the others — feeling real against feeling empty; a sense of system comes from tension between works, not isolation
Mark the masterpiece: admit rank within the series, 'the place I excelled was the Peony' — the completeness of a system must not blunt the edge of its best work
representative_cases_zh: 四梦的镜像配对：《紫钗记》霍小玉因梦重逢，《南柯记》淳于棼因梦散场——同样的'梦中重逢'装置，一个导向圆满一个导向破灭
《邯郸记》卢生的一梦八十百年：黄粱未熟而一生历尽——时间尺度被母题压缩，'梦'成为哲学测量的量具
汤显祖的自我排序：他自言得意处惟在《牡丹亭》——系列作者对自家体系内部的质量梯度有清醒判断
representative_cases_en: The paired mirrors of the four dreams: Huo Xiaoyu reunited through a dream in the purple hairpin, Chun Yufen dispersed through one in the southern bough — the same device of meeting in dream, one to fullness, one to ruin
Lu Sheng's one dream of eighty years in the Handan dream: the millet not yet cooked and a life run through — time compressed by the motif, the dream become a philosophical gauge
Tang Xianzu's own ranking: he said his excelling place was the Peony Pavilion alone — a series author with a clear judgment of the quality gradient inside his own system
modern_applications_zh: 个人知识体系的'四梦结构'：选一个深母题（如'边界''反馈'），围绕它做四个互异的深度项目，而非散点产出——母题让作品互相增值
产品线的母题变奏：同一结构骨架（入梦-历境-出梦）承载不同细分场景——用户靠熟悉结构学习陌生功能
为系列作品做对位设计：写每一篇/每一件时明确它与系列其他成员的对照关系——系列的体系感是设计出来的，不是攒出来的
modern_applications_en: The four-dreams structure for a personal knowledge system: choose one deep motif — boundary, feedback — and build four unlike deep projects around it instead of scattered output; the motif makes works add value to one another
Motif variation across a product line: one structural frame, different segments loaded — users learn strange features through a familiar structure
Design the counterpoint of a series: when writing each piece, state its contrast with the other members — a series's sense of system is designed, never accumulated by accident

modes.name_en: The Method of Feeling Against Principle
modes.category: 方法论/在价值冲突处制造结构化对质
modes.domain_zh: 晚明思想界的主流是程朱理学的'存天理、灭人欲'，汤显祖的整个戏剧体系就是为'情'在这个对峙中争取合法性的战争——《牡丹亭》里这道对峙被写成具体的人物与程序：杜宝要女儿守《毛诗》后妃之德（理），杜丽娘在游园中听见'不到园林，怎知春色如许'（情）；她死后，冥判官查婚姻簿籍无此姻缘（制度之理），判官却仍放她魂游以践前梦（情之特许）；最终还魂成婚，杜宝拒认，直到皇帝下旨裁决（理的最后让步）；这个方法的结构：第一，把抽象冲突翻译成具体情境——'情理之争'不是论说文，而是一个少女、一座花园、一位父亲的裁决；第二，让双方都有最强发言人——杜宝不是反派，他是好父亲、能臣，理的立场被写得最有分量；第三，冲突必须有程序性出口——裁决权交给戏中最高制度（皇帝），而非作者独断；他证明：价值冲突的深度处理不是让一方获胜，而是把双方最强的形态放进同一结构里对质，让观者自己完成裁决
modes.domain_en: The mainstream of late Ming thought held to the Cheng-Zhu maxim 'keep heavenly principle, extinguish human desire'; Tang Xianzu's whole dramatic system was a war to win legitimacy for feeling in that standoff. In the Peony Pavilion the confrontation is written as persons and procedure: Du Bao would have his daughter keep the wifely virtues the Odes teach — principle; Du Liniang in the garden hears 'never had I come to the garden, how should I know such spring' — feeling. After her death the underworld judge finds no such match in the marriage registers — the principle of institution — yet grants her ghost leave to roam and keep her dream — feeling's concession. She returns to life, marries, and Du Bao refuses to acknowledge her until the emperor decrees — principle's last yielding. The structure of the method: first, translate the abstract conflict into a concrete scene — the war of feeling and principle is not an essay but one girl, one garden, one father's verdict. Second, give both sides their strongest spokesman — Du Bao is no villain but a good father and able minister; principle's case is written at full weight. Third, the conflict must have a procedural exit — judgment handed to the play's highest institution, the throne, not to the author's fiat. He proved: deep handling of a value conflict is not one side winning, but both sides' strongest forms set to face each other in one structure, the verdict left to the beholder
modes.source_chapter: 《牡丹亭》第三出'训女'、第七出'闺塾'、第十出'惊梦'、第二十三出'冥判'、第五十三出'硬拷'、第五十五出'圆驾'
modes.key_quote_zh: 价值冲突的深度处理不是让一方获胜，而是把双方最强的形态放进同一结构里对质
modes.key_quote_en: "The deep handling of a value conflict is not one side winning, but both sides' strongest forms set to face each other in one structure."
process_zh: 把抽象价值冲突翻译成具体人物与场景：不让'情理之争'停在口号层，而是落到一个女儿、一座花园、一份判决上
给对立面最强阵容：把对手写成有理有据的好人（杜宝是能臣慈父）——稻草人对质得不出真裁决
在对峙的每个环节都走程序：冥判有簿籍、还魂有仪式、成婚有圣旨——价值裁决必须经由制度通道而非暴力
把最终裁决权交给观者与时代：作者给出最强对质，不在剧终强加判词——深冲突的解决要留给更高的法庭
process_en: Translate the abstract clash of values into persons and scenes: let the war of feeling and principle not stop at slogans but land on one daughter, one garden, one verdict
Field the opposition at full strength: write the adversary a good man with grounds — Du Bao, able minister and loving father; a straw man yields no true verdict

Run every turn of the standoff through procedure: registers in the underworld court, rites for the return, an imperial rescript for the marriage — verdicts on value must go through institutional channels, not force
Leave the last judgment to the beholder and the age: the author stages the strongest confrontation and writes no verdict of his own — deep conflicts are settled in a higher court
representative_cases_zh: '训女'与'惊梦'的对场：父亲白日讲《毛诗》'后妃之德'，女儿同日在花园看见满园春色——同一剧日的两场戏构成情理对峙的最小完整结构
冥判的'依例又通融'：判官按簿籍办事（理）却放魂践梦（情）——制度执行者在程序内为价值留出豁口
'圆驾'的终局设计：父女对峙到最后由皇帝敕命收场——汤显祖不替时代下判词，而是把判决书写在未来的观者手里
representative_cases_en: The paired scenes of 'instructing the daughter' and 'startled by the dream': by day the father expounds the Odes' wifely virtues, the same day the daughter sees the garden's spring — two scenes of one day, the minimal complete structure of feeling against principle
The underworld judge's rule with exception: he proceeds by the registers, principle, yet grants the ghost her dream, feeling — the functionary within procedure leaves an opening for value

The design of the final audience: father and daughter face each other to the last, and the emperor's rescript closes the play — Tang writes no verdict for his age but places the judgment in the hands of watchers to come
modern_applications_zh: 重大决策的'最强反方'制度：立项评审必须由'最相信这个方向会失败的人'陈述反案——对质强度决定裁决质量
把价值冲突写成情境而非标语：公司的'增长与合规''效率与公平'之争，要落到具体角色、具体场景、具体程序上才可裁决
给冲突留程序性出口：裁决走制度通道（仲裁、委员会、用户公测）而非拍板——作者的独断只会推迟冲突
modern_applications_en: The strongest-opposition rule for major decisions: every project review must hear the case from the person who most believes it will fail — the intensity of the confrontation sets the quality of the verdict
Write value conflicts as scenes, not slogans: a company's growth-versus-compliance, efficiency-versus-fairness must land on roles, scenes and procedures before it can be judged
Give conflict a procedural exit: settle through institutions — arbitration, committee, public beta — not executive fiat; the author's decree only defers the clash

modes.definition_zh: 晚明思想界的主流是程朱理学的'存天理、灭人欲'，汤显祖的整个戏剧体系就是为'情'在这个对峙中争取合法性的战争——《牡丹亭》里这道对峙被写成具体的人物与程序：杜宝要女儿守《毛诗》后妃之德（理），杜丽娘在游园中听见'不到园林，怎知春色如许'（情）；她死后，冥判官查婚姻簿籍无此姻缘（制度之理），判官却仍放她魂游以践前梦（情之特许）；最终还魂成婚，杜宝拒认，直到皇帝下旨裁决（理的最后让步）；这个方法的结构：第一，把抽象冲突翻译成具体情境——'情理之争'不是论说文，而是一个少女、一座花园、一位父亲的裁决；第二，让双方都有最强发言人——杜宝不是反派，他是好父亲、能臣，理的立场被写得最有分量；第三，冲突必须有程序性出口——裁决权交给戏中最高制度（皇帝），而非作者独断；他证明：价值冲突的深度处理不是让一方获胜，而是把双方最强的形态放进同一结构里对质，让观者自己完成裁决
modes.definition_en: The mainstream of late Ming thought held to the Cheng-Zhu maxim 'keep heavenly principle, extinguish human desire'; Tang Xianzu's whole dramatic system was a war to win legitimacy for feeling in that standoff. In the Peony Pavilion the confrontation is written as persons and procedure: Du Bao would have his daughter keep the wifely virtues the Odes teach — principle; Du Liniang in the garden hears 'never had I come to the garden, how should I know such spring' — feeling. After her death the underworld judge finds no such match in the marriage registers — the principle of institution — yet grants her ghost leave to roam and keep her dream — feeling's concession. She returns to life, marries, and Du Bao refuses to acknowledge her until the emperor decrees — principle's last yielding. The structure of the method: first, translate the abstract conflict into a concrete scene — the war of feeling and principle is not an essay but one girl, one garden, one father's verdict. Second, give both sides their strongest spokesman — Du Bao is no villain but a good father and able minister; principle's case is written at full weight. Third, the conflict must have a procedural exit — judgment handed to the play's highest institution, the throne, not to the author's fiat. He proved: deep handling of a value conflict is not one side winning, but both sides' strongest forms set to face each other in one structure, the verdict left to the beholder

modes.name_en: The Method of Feeling Dreamed into Form
modes.category: 认知方法/欲望驱动的创作发生学
modes.domain_zh: 《牡丹亭题词》的完整逻辑是'因情成梦，因梦成戏'——汤显祖在此给出一条完整的创作发生链：情（欲望）→梦（虚构）→戏（作品）；这条链的深意：第一，创作的源头动力是未满足的情——杜丽娘的白日梦是被闺塾生活压抑的欲望找到了出口，虚构起于匮乏而非闲暇；第二，'成梦'是技术环节——情要成为梦，必须被转译成有场景、有人物、有时间性的完整表象，这一步是手艺不是灵感；第三，'成戏'是公共化环节——梦是私人的，戏是给天下人看的，作者要为私人情感造出可公共复现的形式（曲牌、排场、脚色）；第四，链条可逆——观众看戏时沿戏→梦→情逆行，作品唤起的情感重新点燃观者自己的生活欲望；他证明：创作不是'表达已有之物'，而是一条能量转换链——情是能源，梦是转换器，戏是电网，输出去的电还能点燃别人的情
modes.domain_en: The full logic of the Peony Pavilion inscription runs, 'feeling forms the dream, the dream forms the play' — Tang Xianzu here lays out a complete chain of creation: feeling, desire; the dream, fiction; the play, the work. The chain's depth: first, the motor of creation is unsatisfied feeling — Du Liniang's waking dream is desire pressed down by schoolroom life finding an exit; fiction begins in want, not leisure. Second, 'forming the dream' is a technical step — feeling becomes dream only when translated into complete representation with scene, persons, and time; this step is craft, not inspiration. Third, 'forming the play' is the step of publicness: the dream is private, the play for all the world — the author must build private feeling a form that reproduces in public, arias, staging, roles. Fourth, the chain runs backward: the audience walks from play to dream to feeling, the work rekindling the desires of their own lives. He proved: creation is not the expression of what already exists but a chain of energy conversion — feeling the fuel, dream the converter, the play the grid, and the power sent out lights the feeling of others

modes.key_quote_zh: 因情成梦，因梦成戏——创作不是表达已有之物，而是一条能量转换链
modes.key_quote_en: "Feeling forms the dream, the dream forms the play — creation is not expressing what exists but a chain of energy conversion."
process_zh: 承认匮乏是创作的能源：诚实地定位自己未满足的情（哪件事没有完成、哪个世界没有抵达）——虚假的起点造不出真作品
把情转译成完整表象：给欲望造场景、人物、时间性，让它从情绪升级为可叙述的世界——'成梦'是手艺活
为私人情感造公共形式：选择可复现的载体（曲牌、格式、框架），让一己之情能被陌生人按形式重演
设计逆行通道：预判观者/用户沿作品逆行时的情感路径——好作品在别人的心里重新点燃源头那种情
process_en: Own that want is creation's fuel: locate honestly the feeling unmet — what deed unfinished, what world unreached; a false起点 cannot make a true work
Translate feeling into complete representation: give desire scene, persons, time, raising it from emotion to a narratable world — forming the dream is craft
Build private feeling a public form: choose a reproducible carrier — arias, formats, frames — so one person's feeling can be re-enacted by strangers
Design the backward channel: anticipate the emotional path by which the audience walks the work in reverse — a great work rekindles in other minds the feeling at its source
representative_cases_zh: 《牡丹亭》的创作次序：先有'闺塾压抑—游园惊梦'的动力结构，再有五十五出的展开——剧作的动力设计先于情节填充
《宜黄县戏神清源师庙记》的戏剧心理学：汤显祖在文中系统论述戏曲'可以合君臣之节、浃父子之恩'——他为'戏'这一公共形式写了完整的能量说明书
汤显祖仕途之憾入曲：他因上《论辅臣科臣疏》贬谪遂昌、终至弃官——政途未遂之情转译为杜丽娘的园林与柳梦梅的科场
representative_cases_en: The order of the Peony Pavilion's making: first the motor structure of schoolroom pressure and garden dream, then the unfolding of fifty-five scenes — the design of drive precedes the filling of plot
The dramatic psychology of the temple record of Yihuang: Tang sets out at length how theater can bind ruler and minister, quicken father and son — an energy manual for the play as public form

The career's defeat turned to drama: his memorial of office cost him exile to Suichang and at last resignation — the feeling of a road not taken translated into Du Liniang's garden and Liu Mengmei's examination hall
modern_applications_zh: 创作卡壳时先查能源：不问'怎么写'先问'这件事里我真实的未满足之情是什么'——技法解决不了能源断供
把'成梦'与'成戏'分开对待：先做私人的完整推演（梦），再为它造公共可复现的形式（戏）——两步混做会互相污染
产品设计的能量链审计：检查产品是否走完'用户之情→使用场景（梦）→可复现形式（戏）'全链——只到达'梦'的产品是自嗨
modern_applications_en: When stuck, check the fuel first: not 'how to write' but 'what true unmet feeling lives in this' — technique cannot fix a fuel shortage
Treat forming the dream and forming the play as separate steps: the private complete projection first, then a publicly reproducible form for it; mixed in one motion, each pollutes the other
An energy chain in product design: check whether the product completes feeling, scene of use, reproducible form — a product stopping at the dream plays only to its maker

尼采（酒神冲动向形式的转化论）

modes.name_en: The Method of Surface and Depth
modes.category: 方法论/同一文本向多层读者开口
modes.domain_zh: 《牡丹亭》是一部可以多层阅读的作品：少年读者看见才子佳人，士大夫看见音律与用典，遗民看见兴亡寄托（如《圆驾》出杜宝坚持'离异了柳梦梅'的礼法顽抗），现代读者看见女性意识觉醒——同一文本向不同时代、不同层次的读者开放不同深度；这个方法是汤显祖有意为之：第一，显层完整自足——只读表层故事也成立（生旦团圆），不给浅读者留下'读不懂'的惩罚；第二，隐层埋设充分——曲词中密集用典（《毛诗》《淮南子》）、情节中安放政治隐喻（他因直谏被贬的身世投射在'论辅臣科臣'的剧情里），深读者有物可挖；第三，层次之间不互斥——深层的解释不推翻表层（杜丽娘既是爱情英雄也是被礼教围困的少女），多层解释共存而非互相取消；他证明：伟大的文本设计不是选一个读者层，而是造一座向所有层开口的建筑——每一层门里都有一间完整的房间
modes.domain_en: The Peony Pavilion is a work built for reading at many levels: the young see gifted youth and the beloved; the lettered see prosody and allusion; survivors of the dynasty's fall see the grief of ruin lodged in scenes like the final audience, where Du Bao's stubborn ritualism fights the marriage; modern readers see a woman's awakening — one text opening different depths to readers of different times and layers. Tang meant it so. First, the surface stands complete: read as story alone it holds — lovers united — and no shallow reader is punished with incomprehension. Second, the depth is fully laid: allusion dense in the arias, the Odes, the Huainanzi; political allegory set in the plot, his own exile for frank memorial projected into the story of office; the deep reader has things to dig. Third, the layers do not exclude one another: the deep reading never overturns the surface — Du Liniang is at once hero of love and girl besieged by rite — readings coexist rather than cancel. He proved: great textual design does not choose one reader but builds a house with a door for every floor — and a whole room behind each door
modes.source_chapter: 《牡丹亭》曲词用典（第七出'闺塾'《毛诗》讲章、第十出'惊梦'【皂罗袍】）；《论辅臣科臣疏》与剧情的身世互文
modes.key_quote_zh: 伟大的文本设计是造一座向所有层开口的建筑——每一层门里都有一间完整的房间
modes.key_quote_en: "Great textual design builds a house with a door for every floor — and a whole room behind each door."
process_zh: 先保证显层完整自足：写完后只读表层做验收——浅读者必须也能得到一个完整体验
为深读者埋设独立价值的隐层：用典、隐喻、自传投射要能单独成立为一套解读——不是显层的装饰而是另一间房
确保层次间不互斥：让深层解释与表层故事兼容（既/又），删掉任何'必须否定表层才能成立'的深读
跨时代测试：问'一百年后的读者从这文本里能挖到什么'——隐层的埋设要以超出当代语境的素材为主
process_en: First make the surface self-sufficient: after drafting, read the surface alone as acceptance — the shallow reader must still get a complete experience
Bury a depth of independent value for deep readers: allusion, allegory, autobiographical projection must stand as a reading on their own — another room, not decoration of the first
Keep the layers from excluding one another: let the deep reading and the surface story be compatible, both-and; cut any deep reading that survives only by denying the surface
Test across eras: ask what a reader a century on can dig from the text — bury depth chiefly in material that outlives the present context
representative_cases_zh: 【皂罗袍】的双层结构：'原来姹紫嫣红开遍，似这般都付与断井颓垣'——表面是园景，深层是青春与礼教的对峙，一句词同时是景语与政论
杜宝拒认还魂女儿的'硬拷'：表层是家庭冲突，深层是汤显祖本人因直言被贬后对体制的复杂态度
'闺塾'出陈最良讲《毛诗》：表层是喜剧化的塾师，深层是对以经学规训女性的整套制度的解剖
representative_cases_en: The two floors of the aria Zaopao: 'so many blossoms blazing over there, all given over to broken wells and fallen walls' — surface a garden scene, depth the standoff of youth and rite, one line both description and indictment
Du Bao's hard interrogation of the returned daughter: surface a family conflict, depth the author's own tangled feeling toward the order that exiled him for plain speech
Chen Cuiliang expounding the Odes in the schoolroom scene: surface a comic pedant, depth a dissection of the whole machinery that disciplined women through the classics
modern_applications_zh: 产品文案的分层验收：新人一眼读懂（显层自足），专家能找到可深挖的细节（隐层充分）——两类读者都不被惩罚
组织文档的'多层房间'设计：会议纪要表层五分钟读完，附录埋完整推导与数据——不同深度的读者各取所需且互不干扰
公开表达的身份分层：一篇内容同时向公众、同业、未来自己三层开口——写完逐层自问'这一层能拿到什么'
modern_applications_en: Layered acceptance for product copy: a newcomer reads it at a glance, an expert finds details worth digging — neither reader punished
Rooms by floor in organizational documents: the minutes read in five minutes on the surface, full derivations and data buried in the appendix — readers of each depth served without interference
Identity layering in public writing: one piece opening to the public, the trade, and one's future self; when it is done, ask each floor what it takes away

modes.name_en: The Method of Meaning Over Meter
modes.category: 方法论/内容标准与形式标准的排序
modes.domain_zh: 晚明曲坛的大论战是汤显祖与沈璟之争：沈璟一派主张'宁协律而词不工'——格律是底线，文辞可以为此牺牲；汤显祖针锋相对地提出'凡文以意趣神色为主'——意趣神色（内容与生命的品质）是主，格律是仆，'四者到时，或有丽词俊音可用，尔时能一一顾九宫四声否'；这场论战的普遍意义在于它是一个排序公案：第一，确定何者不可让——汤显祖宁可'拗折天下人嗓子'也不肯伤意趣，他把'作品为什么存在'置于'作品如何被规范'之上；第二，形式妥协的边界要明说——他不否认格律，只是宣布当两者冲突时的裁决次序；第三，承担排序的代价——《牡丹亭》因不合吴江派律谱屡遭改窜，汤显祖宁让'玉茗堂'本流传而不改一字，代价由传播承担；他证明：任何领域都有'主'与'仆'两个标准层，成熟从业者的标志不是两者兼顾，而是清楚知道冲突时牺牲谁——并愿意为排序付出可见的代价
modes.domain_en: The great quarrel of the late Ming stage set Tang Xianzu against Shen Jing: Shen's school held 'rather keep the meter though the words suffer' — prosody the floor, diction its sacrifice. Tang answered, 'all writing takes meaning, flavor, spirit, color as master': the quality of content and life is lord, meter servant — 'when the four are present and a fine word or brave note offers itself, can one still wait on the nine modes and four tones?' The quarrel's general meaning is a case in ordering: first, settle what may not be yielded — Tang would rather 'bend the whole world's throat' than wound the meaning; he placed why the work exists above how it is regulated. Second, the boundary of formal compromise must be spoken: he never denied prosody, only declared the order of judgment when the two collide. Third, bear the price of the ordering — the Peony Pavilion, off the Wujiang school's scales, was altered again and again; Tang let the Yumingtang text stand a single unaltered word, and the cost was carried by transmission. He proved: every field has a master standard and a servant one; the mature practitioner is marked not by balancing both but by knowing whom to sacrifice at the clash — and paying, visibly, for the ordering
modes.source_chapter: 汤显祖《答吕姜山》：'凡文以意趣神色为主，四者到时，或有丽词俊音可用，尔时能一一顾九宫四声否'；与沈璟'宁协律而词不工'之争
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡文以意趣神色为主——成熟从业者不是两者兼顾，而是清楚知道冲突时牺牲谁
modes.key_quote_en: "All writing takes meaning, flavor, spirit, color as master — the mature practitioner does not balance both, but knows whom to sacrifice at the clash."
process_zh: 先做标准的本体排序：列出本领域的两个标准层（内容价值/形式规范），明确宣告何者为主——排序宣言本身就是立场
为'主'设定不可让渡条款：写出'宁可拗折嗓子也不伤意趣'级别的底线——没有底线的排序会在第一次冲突时溃败
为'仆'保留合法性：承认格律的价值，只宣布冲突时的裁决次序——极端的主仆观会把形式价值也丢掉
预付排序的代价：想清楚排序会得罪谁、付出什么（被改窜、被排斥），并接受它——不敢付代价的排序是空话
process_en: First order the standards: list the field's two layers — content value, formal rule — and declare which is master; the declaration itself is the position
Set an unyieldable clause for the master: write a bottom line at the level of 'rather bend the world's throat than wound the meaning'; an ordering without one collapses at the first clash
Keep legitimacy for the servant: concede prosody's worth, declaring only the order of judgment in collision — a master-servant view pushed to the extreme loses the formal value too
Prepay the price of the ordering: know whom it offends and what it costs — being altered, being shunned — and accept it; an ordering whose price is not paid is empty talk
representative_cases_zh: '拗折天下人嗓子'的宣言：汤显祖公开声明宁可不协律也不伤意趣——把排序从私下偏好升格为公开立场
拒绝改窜《牡丹亭》：吕玉绳等依吴江派律谱改其词，汤显祖复信断然拒绝，坚称'彼恶知曲意哉'——为排序承受传播分裂的代价
宜黄班的排演实践：他为演员讲'情之所必至'的戏理而非只教工尺——在演出一线贯彻'意趣为主'的排序
representative_cases_en: The declaration of bending the world's throat: Tang said openly he would rather break meter than meaning — raising an ordering from private taste to public position

The refusal to let the Peony be emended: when Lü Yusheng and others reworked his words to the Wujiang scales, he refused flat — 'how should they know the meaning of the song' — bearing the cost of a split transmission

Rehearsal practice with the Yihuang troupe: he taught the players the sense of the play, where feeling must arrive, not the pipes alone — the ordering of meaning over meter carried into the working theater
modern_applications_zh: 为团队写出标准的裁决次序：'代码质量与交付时间冲突时牺牲谁''画面质感与上线日期冲突时谁让'——写明次序的团队不再内耗于每次冲突
识别自己领域的'沈璟陷阱'：把形式合规（格式、流程、KPI）当底线而牺牲内容价值的组织，会得到完美执行平庸作品
为排序付可见代价：像汤显祖拒绝改窜一样，关键作品拒绝为合规性改动内核——不付费用的标准排序没人当真
modern_applications_en: Write the order of judgment for a team's standards: when code quality and ship date clash, who yields; when craft and launch date clash — a team with the order written stops bleeding on every conflict
Spot the Shen Jing trap in one's own field: organizations that make formal compliance the floor and sacrifice content value will execute mediocrity to perfection
Pay visibly for the ordering: as Tang refused emendation, refuse in the keystone works any change to the core for compliance's sake — an ordering no one pays for is taken seriously by no one

modes.definition_zh: 晚明曲坛的大论战是汤显祖与沈璟之争：沈璟一派主张'宁协律而词不工'——格律是底线，文辞可以为此牺牲；汤显祖针锋相对地提出'凡文以意趣神色为主'——意趣神色（内容与生命的品质）是主，格律是仆，'四者到时，或有丽词俊音可用，尔时能一一顾九宫四声否'；这场论战的普遍意义在于它是一个排序公案：第一，确定何者不可让——汤显祖宁可'拗折天下人嗓子'也不肯伤意趣，他把'作品为什么存在'置于'作品如何被规范'之上；第二，形式妥协的边界要明说——他不否认格律，只是宣布当两者冲突时的裁决次序；第三，承担排序的代价——《牡丹亭》因不合吴江派律谱屡遭改窜，汤显祖宁让'玉茗堂'本流传而不改一字，代价由传播承担；他证明：任何领域都有'主'与'仆'两个标准层，成熟从业者的标志不是两者兼顾，而是清楚知道冲突时牺牲谁——并愿意为排序付出可见的代价
modes.definition_en: The great quarrel of the late Ming stage set Tang Xianzu against Shen Jing: Shen's school held 'rather keep the meter though the words suffer' — prosody the floor, diction its sacrifice. Tang answered, 'all writing takes meaning, flavor, spirit, color as master': the quality of content and life is lord, meter servant — 'when the four are present and a fine word or brave note offers itself, can one still wait on the nine modes and four tones?' The quarrel's general meaning is a case in ordering: first, settle what may not be yielded — Tang would rather 'bend the whole world's throat' than wound the meaning; he placed why the work exists above how it is regulated. Second, the boundary of formal compromise must be spoken: he never denied prosody, only declared the order of judgment when the two collide. Third, bear the price of the ordering — the Peony Pavilion, off the Wujiang school's scales, was altered again and again; Tang let the Yumingtang text stand a single unaltered word, and the cost was carried by transmission. He proved: every field has a master standard and a servant one; the mature practitioner is marked not by balancing both but by knowing whom to sacrifice at the clash — and paying, visibly, for the ordering

modes.name_en: The Method of Building the Troupe
modes.category: 方法论/为自己的作品建设执行载体
modes.domain_zh: 汤显祖不满足于写戏，他亲手建设了戏的执行载体：万历年间宜黄艺人从一千余人锐减到四散零落，汤显祖弃官归临川后，'去县数千里，犹自敦促'宜伶组织戏班（宜黄班），写《宜黄县戏神清源师庙记》为这个行当立传正名，并亲自为演员讲解戏理——他的剧本是为了'有人能演'而存在的技术文档；这个方法的四个环节：第一，识别载体危机——作品没有可靠的演出载体等于没有完成，剧本散佚与误改的风险由载体质量决定；第二，亲自介入载体建设——写庙记、教戏理、定标准，作者下场做执行侧的组织工作；第三，为载体写'说明书'——《庙记》既是行业史也是操作手册（声腔源流、表演规范、动情机制）；第四，让载体反哺作品——宜黄班的演出实践让《牡丹亭》的排场在舞台上被验证和调整；他证明：作品的生命力 = 内容质量 × 载体质量——一流内容配上衰亡载体，等于没有内容
modes.domain_en: Tang Xianzu did not stop at writing plays: he built their carrier of execution. In the Wanli years the players of Yihuang, once more than a thousand, had scattered and thinned; retired to Linchuan, Tang urged on the Yihuang actors the forming of a troupe, wrote the temple record of the stage god of Qingyuan to give the calling a history and a name, and taught the actors the sense of the plays himself — his scripts existed as technical documents for 'someone able to perform them.' The method's four pieces: first, see the carrier's crisis — a work without a reliable carrier of performance is unfinished, and the risk of loss and corruption is set by the carrier's quality. Second, enter the carrier's building oneself — the temple record, the teaching, the standards: the author comes down to do the organizational work of execution. Third, write the carrier a manual — the temple record is at once a history of the calling and an operating document, origins of the vocal style, rules of playing, the mechanics of moving an audience. Fourth, let the carrier feed back into the work — the troupe's practice tested and adjusted the Peony Pavilion's staging on the boards. He proved: a work's life equals its content times its carrier — first-rate content on a dying carrier is content no longer
modes.source_chapter: 汤显祖《宜黄县戏神清源师庙记》：'宜黄谭大司马纶闻而恶之……此道有从不食者'；汤显祖与宜伶往来诗（'半学侬歌小梵音'等）
modes.key_quote_zh: 作品的生命力 = 内容质量 × 载体质量——一流内容配上衰亡载体，等于没有内容
modes.key_quote_en: "A work's life is its content times its carrier — first-rate content on a dying carrier is content no longer."
process_zh: 审计作品载体现状：作品将由谁执行、执行者是否稳定、误改风险多高——载体危机是作品存亡的前置问题
亲自下场建设载体：为执行者立传正名（庙记）、定规范、教方法——作者不碰执行侧，作品命运就交给了别人
为载体写操作说明：把'怎么演、怎么教、为何动人'写成可传承的文档——载体的制度比载体的热情更可靠
建立载体→作品的反馈回路：从演出实践中回收排场与文本的修正——载体不是作品的下游，是共同演化者
process_en: Audit the work's carrier: who executes it, are they stable, how high the risk of corruption — the carrier's crisis precedes the work's survival
Build the carrier with one's own hands: give the executors a history and a name, set standards, teach the method — an author who never touches execution leaves the work's fate to others
Write the carrier its operating manual: how to play, how to teach, why it moves — put down as transmissible documents; a carrier's institutions are more reliable than its enthusiasm
Build the feedback loop from carrier to work: recover corrections of staging and text from performance practice — the carrier is not downstream of the work but its co-evolver
representative_cases_zh: 宜黄班的组建：汤显祖敦促宜伶从散落状态重组成稳定戏班——为《牡丹亭》确保了首演与传播的执行单位
《宜黄县戏神清源师庙记》的书写：全文追溯戏曲源流、论证戏曲动情之力、为伶人立神——一次为执行载体正名的完整写作工程
与宜伶的诗往与教学：'情隐有真假，韵狭有平仄'——他给演员讲的是表演的判断标准，不是台词背诵
representative_cases_en: The forming of the Yihuang troupe: Tang pressed the scattered Yihuang actors into a stable company — securing for the Peony Pavilion a unit of first performance and spread
The writing of the temple record: tracing drama's origins, arguing its power to move, enthroning the players' patron god — a whole writing project to give the carrier standing
Poems exchanged with the players and his teaching: feeling has true and false, rhyme narrow and level — he taught the actors standards of judgment, not lines to memorize
modern_applications_zh: 开源作者的'宜黄班'意识：好项目需要配套的执行载体（维护团队、CI、文档）——只发代码不管载体的项目会死于误改
为内部方法论写'庙记'：把方法论的来源、价值与操作规范写成正式文档——给执行者立正名比喊口号更能留住人
作者下场做组织工作：核心作品的作者亲自带教第一代执行者（新人、外包、代理商）——载体质量决定作品是否被误传
modern_applications_en: The Yihuang consciousness for open-source authors: a good project needs its carrier of execution — maintainers, CI, documents; code shipped without its carrier dies of corruption
Write the temple record for an internal methodology: its origins, its worth, its operating rules, set down formally; standing given to executors retains them better than slogans

The author descends to organizational work: the maker of a keystone work personally teaches its first generation of executors — newcomers, vendors, agencies; carrier quality decides whether the work arrives corrupted

modes.name_en: The Method of Resigning for the Vocation
modes.category: 个人品格/以辞职完成身份重定义
modes.domain_zh: 万历二十六年（1598），汤显祖在遂昌知县任上五年、政绩清声俱佳的情况下，正式弃官归临川——不待考察、不候升迁、不待贬令，主动终结仕途；这不是失意者的退场，而是一次精确的身份重定义：第一，成本计算先行——他看清了万历朝政（矿税之祸、首辅专权）下'良吏'的天花板，判断继续做官的机会成本高于弃官；第二，用行动而非言论表态——他没有写退隐文章感叹世道，而是直接交印走人，让仕途的终结本身成为作品《牡丹亭》开笔的资源（同年完成）；第三，把身份资本转移而非清零——弃官不是放弃积累，而是把'遂昌清声''直谏旧臣'的政治资本转投戏剧事业（乡望与文名替他在士林中背书）；第四，承担终身代价——弃官带来多年'蹭蹬穷老'的困顿，他不再回头；他证明：当体制身份与真实志业冲突时，最高级的解法不是在体制内继续表演，而是用一次彻底的退场把全部身份资本定向转移给志业
modes.domain_en: In the twenty-sixth year of Wanli, 1598, Tang Xianzu, five years magistrate of Suichang with a clean record and good name, formally resigned and went home to Linchuan — awaiting no review, no promotion, no edict of demotion, he ended his official career himself. This was not the exit of a disappointed man but a precise redefinition of identity. First, the costing came first: he saw the ceiling over a good official in the Wanli court, the mine-tax plague, the chief minister's grip, and judged the opportunity cost of office higher than the cost of leaving. Second, the act, not the essay: he wrote no lament on retiring from the world but handed over the seal and walked — the ending of the career itself becoming, that same year, the resource of the Peony Pavilion's first draft. Third, the transfer, not the erasure, of identity capital: resignation gave up nothing he had earned — the clean name of Suichang, the old frank memorialist — capital redirected into drama, his local standing and literary name standing surety among the gentry. Fourth, the lifelong price borne: the resigned life brought years of hardship, 'stumbling and poor to old age,' and he never turned back. He proved: when the institutional identity and the true vocation conflict, the highest solution is not to go on performing inside the system but to exit once and utterly, transferring all identity capital, directed, to the vocation
modes.source_chapter: 《明史·汤显祖传》载弃官事；汤显祖《论辅臣科臣疏》（万历十九年上，贬徐闻典史）；万历二十六年弃遂昌知县归临川，同年成《牡丹亭》
modes.key_quote_zh: 当体制身份与真实志业冲突时，最高级的解法是用一次彻底的退场把全部身份资本定向转移给志业
modes.key_quote_en: "When institutional identity and true vocation conflict, the highest solution is one utter exit, transferring all identity capital, directed, to the vocation."
process_zh: 先算体制内机会成本：冷静评估留在体制里的天花板与代价（不是一时委屈，而是十年尺度）——弃与不弃是计算题不是情绪题
用行动代替言论：决定退场时不写宣言、不做姿态，直接完成程序性退出——行动的清晰度高于任何声明
把身份资本定向转移：列出在旧身份里积累的信誉、技能、人脉，逐项映射到新志业的用途上——退场是转移不是清零
预付并承受终身代价：写明退场后失去什么（俸禄、体面、上升通道），并在困顿期不回头——可逆的退场不是重定义
process_en: Cost the ceiling inside the system first: coolly assess what staying yields and costs at a ten-year scale, not one slight; leaving or staying is calculation, not mood
Let the act replace the essay: once decided, no manifesto, no pose — complete the procedural exit; the clarity of the act outruns any declaration
Transfer the identity capital, directed: list the credit, skill and connections earned under the old identity and map each to the new vocation's use — the exit is a transfer, not an erasure
Prepay and bear the lifelong price: state plainly what resignation forfeits — stipend, standing, ascent — and do not turn back in the lean years; a reversible exit is no redefinition
representative_cases_zh: 遂昌任上的判断依据：政声虽好，但矿税使横行、朝政日非，'良吏'已无施展空间——他在政绩最好的年份选择离开，说明决策基于趋势而非挫折
弃官与《牡丹亭》同年：1598年既是仕途终点也是玉茗堂创作起点——退场的动能直接转化为创作的资源
晚年拒不复出：弃官后虽有荐举，他终身不复出仕——退场的彻底性是其可信度的来源
representative_cases_en: The grounds judged in Suichang: good name though he had, the mine-tax commissioners ran loose and the court worsened by the day, and the good official had no ground to stand on — he left in his best years of praise, a decision from the trend, not a setback
Resignation and the Peony in one year: 1598, end of the career and start of the Yumingtang workshop — the momentum of the exit converted straight into the resource of creation
No return in old age: recommendations came, and he never took office again — the utterness of the exit is the source of its credibility
modern_applications_zh: 职业转换的'机会成本审计'：每三年冷静核算一次'留在现体制的十年天花板'——在最好的年份做的转型决策质量高于受挫后的仓皇决定
退场动作的程序化：离职不写檄文、不留伏笔，干净完成交接——退场的干净程度决定新身份的起点高度
身份资本转移清单：转行前逐项列出旧身份资产（声誉、方法论、网络）并写明在新领域的兑换路径——没有转移清单的转行等于从零开始
modern_applications_en: The opportunity-cost audit of a career: every three years, coolly price the ten-year ceiling of staying in the present system; transitions decided in the best years beat hasty ones made in defeat
Proceduralize the exit: no manifesto, no loose threads — a clean handover; the cleanliness of the exit sets the height of the new identity's start

The transfer list of identity capital: before switching fields, list the assets of the old identity — reputation, method, network — and write each one's redemption path in the new; without the list, a switch starts from zero

modes.definition_zh: 万历二十六年（1598），汤显祖在遂昌知县任上五年、政绩清声俱佳的情况下，正式弃官归临川——不待考察、不候升迁、不待贬令，主动终结仕途；这不是失意者的退场，而是一次精确的身份重定义：第一，成本计算先行——他看清了万历朝政（矿税之祸、首辅专权）下'良吏'的天花板，判断继续做官的机会成本高于弃官；第二，用行动而非言论表态——他没有写退隐文章感叹世道，而是直接交印走人，让仕途的终结本身成为作品《牡丹亭》开笔的资源（同年完成）；第三，把身份资本转移而非清零——弃官不是放弃积累，而是把'遂昌清声''直谏旧臣'的政治资本转投戏剧事业（乡望与文名替他在士林中背书）；第四，承担终身代价——弃官带来多年'蹭蹬穷老'的困顿，他不再回头；他证明：当体制身份与真实志业冲突时，最高级的解法不是在体制内继续表演，而是用一次彻底的退场把全部身份资本定向转移给志业
modes.definition_en: In the twenty-sixth year of Wanli, 1598, Tang Xianzu, five years magistrate of Suichang with a clean record and good name, formally resigned and went home to Linchuan — awaiting no review, no promotion, no edict of demotion, he ended his official career himself. This was not the exit of a disappointed man but a precise redefinition of identity. First, the costing came first: he saw the ceiling over a good official in the Wanli court, the mine-tax plague, the chief minister's grip, and judged the opportunity cost of office higher than the cost of leaving. Second, the act, not the essay: he wrote no lament on retiring from the world but handed over the seal and walked — the ending of the career itself becoming, that same year, the resource of the Peony Pavilion's first draft. Third, the transfer, not the erasure, of identity capital: resignation gave up nothing he had earned — the clean name of Suichang, the old frank memorialist — capital redirected into drama, his local standing and literary name standing surety among the gentry. Fourth, the lifelong price borne: the resigned life brought years of hardship, 'stumbling and poor to old age,' and he never turned back. He proved: when the institutional identity and the true vocation conflict, the highest solution is not to go on performing inside the system but to exit once and utterly, transferring all identity capital, directed, to the vocation

modes.name_en: The Method of the One Lamp at Yumingtang
modes.category: 个人品格/以孤守完成体系的终局验证
modes.domain_zh: 汤显祖晚年在临川玉茗堂完成最后的作品并于此终老（1616），堂名取自白玉茗花——他把自己的书斋命名为一种花，也把一生志业的收束点选在这里：面对吴江派改窜其作、朝堂讥其'不慧'、生计困顿，他没有寻求和解也没有改变路线，而是在玉茗堂一盏灯下继续写《邯郸记》《南柯记》修订与尺牍，把'至情'体系推进到底；这个方法的深意：第一，孤守不是孤立——玉茗堂是与宜黄班、与门生、与天下读者保持通信的枢纽，孤守的是标准而非关系；第二，终局验证靠作品而非辩解——面对'音律之诮'他不再写论战文章，而是让《南柯记》《邯郸记》在同样的'拗嗓'下照样动人，用作品完成对批评的最终回答；第三，命名即宣言——'玉茗'之洁把美学标准写进日常空间，堂号成了体系的注册商标；第四，以身殉式收束——他死于万历四十四年，与莎士比亚同年，四百年来'临川四梦'仍在演出，体系的终局验证由时间完成；他证明：一个体系的最后防线不是论辩的胜负，而是创始人是否愿意在没有援军的年月里，仍按自己的标准交付作品——灯还在，体系就还在
modes.domain_en: Tang Xianzu's late years passed in the Yumingtang at Linchuan, where he finished his last works and died in 1616; the hall took its name from a flower of white jade tea — he named his study for a blossom and set there the closing point of his life's work. Against the Wujiang school's emendations, the court's sneer at his dullness, and pinched means, he neither sought peace nor changed course, but wrote on under one lamp — revising the Handan and Southern Bough dreams, keeping his letters — driving the system of sovereign feeling to the end. The method's depth: first, keeping alone is not being alone — the Yumingtang was a hub of letters to the troupe, to pupils, to readers everywhere; what he kept alone was the standard, not the ties. Second, the final answer is the work, not the defense — against the mockery of his meter he wrote no polemic but let the later dreams move audiences all the same, off-bend and alive; the works answered the critics at last. Third, the name is the manifesto: the purity of white jade tea wrote an aesthetic standard into daily space; the hall's name became the system's mark. Fourth, the closing sealed with a life: he died in the forty-fourth year of Wanli, the same year as Shakespeare, and four hundred years on the four dreams are still played — the system's final verification finished by time. He proved: a system's last line of defense is not the victory of argument but whether its founder will still deliver work to his own standard in the years without reinforcements — while the lamp burns, the system stands
modes.source_chapter: 汤显祖卒于万历四十四年（1616），与莎士比亚同年；玉茗堂为其临川书斋，'玉茗堂'本《牡丹亭》为其自定传世版本；晚年尺牍（《答凌初升》等）
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个体系的最后防线不是论辩的胜负，而是创始人是否愿意在没有援军的年月里仍按自己的标准交付作品
modes.key_quote_en: "A system's last line of defense is not the victory of argument but whether its founder still delivers work to his own standard in the years without reinforcements."
process_zh: 把工作空间注册为体系地标：给长期 workspace 命名并注入意义（玉茗堂）——空间的仪式感是标准的日常提醒
孤守标准而非切断关系：批评声浪中继续通信、教学、回信——孤守的对象是质量标准，不是社交网络
用作品而非论战作终局回答：面对体系性批评，把精力投入下一个符合标准的作品——作品是唯一不可被改写答辩状
指定标准载体并坚守：像'玉茗堂本'一样为体系确定自定版本——别人改你的作品时，标准载体是最终仲裁者
process_en: Register the workspace as the system's landmark: name the long-term workshop and load it with meaning, as Yumingtang was; the ritual of space is a daily reminder of the standard
Keep the standard, not the isolation: in the noise of criticism, keep writing, teaching, answering; what is kept alone is the quality bar, never the network
Answer at the end with the work, not the polemic: against a systematic criticism, spend the strength on the next work to standard — the work is the one defense none can rewrite
Fix the standard carrier and hold it: as the Yumingtang edition, designate the system's self-defined version; when others alter your work, the standard carrier is the final arbiter
representative_cases_zh: '玉茗堂本'的确立：面对他人改本（如'硕园删定本'），汤显祖以自定本传世——体系的关键资产（版本权）被创始人亲手锁定
《答凌初升》的克制：对音律批评者作技术性回应而不失风度——孤守标准与保持对话在他笔下并存
与莎士比亚同年而卒：1616年东西方两位戏剧家同时离世，四百年演出史成为'临川四梦'体系的时间验证
representative_cases_en: The fixing of the Yumingtang edition: against altered texts, the Shuoyuan abridgment among them, Tang's self-defined text stood as the one handed down — the system's key asset, the version right, locked by the founder's hand
The restraint of the letter to Ling Chusheng: a technical answer to the metrical critics, and no loss of grace — keeping the standard and keeping the dialogue coexist in his brush
Dying in the year of Shakespeare: 1616, the two masters of the stage taken in the same year — four hundred years of playing since have been time's own verification of the four dreams
modern_applications_zh: 为个人体系锁定'标准载体'：核心方法论要有自定版本（canonical repo、署名文档）——被转述走样时以标准载体仲裁
批评期投入下一件标准作品：体系受质疑时不打口水仗，把资源投入下一个达标产出——作品是体系的最终辩护
给长期工作空间注入地标意义：为书房/仓库/频道命名并立意——空间意义感是孤守期的心理基础设施
modern_applications_en: Lock the standard carrier of one's system: the core methodology needs a self-defined version — the canonical repo, the signed document; when retellings drift, the standard carrier arbitrates

In the season of criticism, fund the next standard work: when the system is doubted, no war of words — put the resources into the next output that meets the bar; the work is the system's final defense

Load the long-term workspace with landmark meaning: name the study, the repository, the channel, and give it intent — the meaning of space is the psychological infrastructure of the years without reinforcements
